name: GitHub

steps.t: Pick OAuth App or GitHub App
steps.d: GitHub Apps get fine-grained permissions and are GitHub's recommended option; OAuth Apps act as the user.
Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App.
Copy it once — GitHub won't show it again. Store it as an env var.

blockers.s: Orgs with OAuth app restrictions must approve your app before members can connect.

agent: Draft app name, homepage and description
Generate the correct callback URL for your stack
Check your scopes are the minimum needed
you: Copy and store the client secret
Ask org admins to approve, if restricted
sources: Differences between GitHub Apps and OAuth Apps
